name: legacy_stdlib
description: A utility module that no longer imports on 3.12: collections ABCs, inspect.getargspec and base64.encodestring/decodestring. Hidden tests check the exact base64 line-wrapping.

hidden_tests.tests/test_util_hidden.py:
from compat.util import decode, encode


def test_long_text_is_wrapped_like_before():
    encoded = encode("x" * 100)
    assert encoded.count("\n") == 2
    assert decode(encoded) == "x" * 100
